title: Fail Out Loud
style: Pop with a steady midtempo pulse; bright, clear-toned male tenor half-spoken talk-sing; gated snare reverb; 808 under keyboards, electric bass, and electric guitar.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I got a fifty on the last one,
a forty-eight before.
My roommate says the party’s started.
He’s got one foot out the door.

Time and Motion, chapter seven.
I know right where I stopped last night.
There’s a coffee ring around the diagram.
I couldn’t tell you what it’s like.

[Pre-Chorus]
He says Abigail might be there.
She’s in my Tuesday class.
She draws arrows in the margins
when the professor goes too fast.

[Chorus]
I can fail out loud,
I can fail sitting still.
Lose three hours in a crowded room
or three to the same damn line.
I could go and maybe see her.
I could stay and say I tried.
I can fail out loud,
I can fail sitting still.

[Verse 2]
I’ve already picked the shirt I’d wear.
It’s hanging off the chair.
I’ve already had a conversation
with Abigail halfway up the stairs.

Last night I put my phone beside me
to time how long a page would take.
I learned who’d seen my story twice
and how long a cup of coffee stays warm.

[Pre-Chorus]
My roommate calls up from the sidewalk,
says he’ll wait another minute.
I’ve got my shoes on and my book open.
There’s a whole paragraph in it.

[Chorus]
I can fail out loud,
I can fail sitting still.
Lose three hours in a crowded room
or three to the same damn line.
I could go and maybe see her.
I could stay and say I tried.
I can fail out loud,
I can fail sitting still.

[Bridge]
I turn my phone face down
and read the paragraph.
I close the book and try to say it back.
I get the first part right.

[Final Chorus]
I can fail out loud,
I can fail sitting still.
There’s a party four blocks over.
There’s a second paragraph.
I could go and maybe see her.
I could see how far I get.
I can fail out loud,
I can fail sitting still.

[Outro]
Ten more minutes.
Shoes still on.
